# UI5 Modernization

Skills that teach agents to work with UI5 Modernization. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [UI5/plugins-coding-agents](https://github.com/UI5/plugins-coding-agents), at commit `2b8c4a9`.

Complete UI5 modernization toolkit with workflow and specialized fix patterns for modernizing SAPUI5/OpenUI5 applications

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **UI5 Modernization**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **UI5 Modernization**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install ui5-modernization@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

19 skills: `fix-bootstrap-params`, `fix-component-async`, `fix-control-renderer`, `fix-csp-compliance`, `fix-cyclic-deps`, `fix-deprecated-controls`, `fix-fiori-elements-extensions`, `fix-js-globals`, `fix-library-init`, `fix-linter-blind-spots`, `fix-manifest-json`, `fix-partially-deprecated-apis`, `fix-pseudo-modules`, `fix-table-row-mode`, `fix-xml-globals`, `fix-xml-native-html`, `modernize-flp-sandbox`, `modernize-test-starter`, `modernize-ui5-app`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

25 script files ship inside the skills. The agent can run them on your machine. Read them first.
